rules.notLiteral: 0, 0px, auto, inherit, initial, unset, none, normal, currentColor, transparent, 100%, 1 (opacity), 0/1 z-index 0 are not literals
rules.varOnly: values built only from var(--token), calc() of tokens and color-mix() of tokens are not literals; the percentages inside a token color-mix are counted separately as "mixRatio" (ad-hoc derived colours)
rules.fallback: a literal inside var(--x, <literal>) is a fallback, counted as status "fallback", not a violation
rules.keyframes: declarations inside @keyframes are motion frames: counted only for colour
rules.hairline: 1px and 2px in spacing/borders are sub-grid hairlines: status "subgrid", not counted as violations
rules.relative: em/%/vw/ch/dvh/cqw values are relative: status "relative" (they scale with their parent, unlike px), not violations
rules.dollywood: Dollywood template: selectors are split by flavour ([data-flavor=hub] = build guide only, [data-flavor=live] = park map only, html:not([data-flavor=live]) = build guide/standalone); lines 259-308 and 525-565 and SVG-shape selectors are cartography (colour exempt, as scripts/screens-apps.mjs allows); the :where(:root) / :where([data-theme=light]) palette blocks (lines 7-12) are standalone-only (overridden by the hub flavour block at line 212) except the map category colours
rules.designCss: apps/design.css: only declarations outside the token/theme/kind blocks are scanned (the component layer, resets, print)
rules.meta: <meta name="theme-color"> hex is counted in category colour with status "meta" (a token cannot reach a meta tag; hub.js/index.html set it from JS)
